message.content: ATP synthase (also called F₁F₀‑ATPase) is the enzyme complex embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane that uses the proton motive force generated by the electron transport chain to catalyze the synthesis of ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. As protons flow back into the matrix through the F₀ channel, the energy drives rotation of the catalytic F₁ subunit, driving the phosphorylation reaction and producing the cell’s main energy currency.
